name: probit-field-p1
description: Probit-only field (analyst 6.96 D; launched 2026-11-12 ~21:30 by the coordinator). In ladder-2 the ply-1 top 12 (903-921) are all probit trees/DAGs from probit-only fields while the mixed std field's models sit 20-170 lower. ONE FACTOR vs std-v1-p1-s1: the field's composition. The standard's 4 probit recipes (F-P, T-P-Ne capped, T-P-Ne-grow, D-P-Ne-ctx-grow) x2 replicates = 8 lines, so the field size, games per cycle and data per line match the std field; seed 65, T 0.1, the same binaries. Read at v300 against the r/e/g/h panel @300, vs std-v1-p1-s1's probit lines v300. Band (6.96): 20-50 over the std's probit lines => single-leaf-family standards; within 15 => selection, the mixed standard stands. Cap 301.
